command:
set -eu
export PYTHONUTF8=1
export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8
export TMPDIR="$(cygpath -u "$R95_TMPROOT")"
export R95_CANON_TMP="$(realpath "$TMPDIR")"
rm() {
  if [ "$#" -ne 2 ] || [ "$1" != "-rf" ]; then echo "R95 cleanup shape rejected" >&2; return 98; fi
  local resolved
  resolved="$(realpath "$2")" || return 98
  case "$resolved" in "$R95_CANON_TMP"/*) command rm -rf -- "$resolved";; *) echo "R95 cleanup outside owned temp rejected" >&2; return 98;; esac
}
export -f rm
bash scripts/ci.sh
isolation: Unmodified scripts/ci.sh, private pre-engine APPDATA/XDG and stock per-probe namespaces; verified owned TMPDIR cleanup. No gate or probe modifications.
scope: One Geologist painted-pan code and texture import; no new PNGpixels. Machine lane only; formal QA11, integration and device/child/owner remain separate.
